items.brief: XRP Ledger adds controls for banks, stablecoins and tokenized funds
items.why: New account permissions may aid tokenized fund and stablecoin operations.

items.brief: Citrini: tokenization boom could have bigger winners than bitcoin, ether
items.why: Tokenized stocks, bonds and loans may create new trading and lending markets.

items.brief: Securitize stock jumps over 10% after tokenized US equities on Solana
items.why: Tokenized equities with dividends and voting rights expand tokenized asset offerings.

items.brief: Crédit Agricole insurance arm invests €100m in tokenized Amundi money fund
items.why: Large institutional investment signals growing adoption of tokenized funds.

items.brief: IMF warns tokenized markets could amplify financial risks
items.why: Tokenized equity markets found less liquid and more volatile than traditional.

items.brief: EU regulator gives crypto platforms 3 months to remove unauthorized stablecoins
items.why: MiCA enforcement shapes which stablecoins can support tokenized markets in EU.

items.brief: Cardano Foundation spins out Veridian, tokenizes its shares on new standard
items.why: First use of Cardano's programmable-token standard for tokenized equity.

items.brief: Securitize launches 1:1-backed tokenized stocks, starting with Apple, Nvidia
items.why: Tokenized stocks backed 1:1 by real shares with dividends and USDC settlement.

items.brief: Fidelity: 'no going back' for institutions moving toward tokenized onchain future
items.why: Tokenization offers structural advantages and helps asset managers reach markets.

items.brief: Samsung to launch USDC transfers on Solana for US Galaxy users
items.why: Stablecoin transfers built into Samsung Wallet with fiat on- and off-ramps, not a separate crypto app.
